Dear Oliver Poganatz,
thank you for contacting Siemens eMobility Technical Support.
Our Technical Support team will create an official case in our ticketing system shortly and will inform you accordingly through email, including the official  case number of the incident.
Please wait till you get the offical reply from us and do not reply to this email, since it will not be monitored

vielen Dank dass Sie sich bei Siemens eMobility Technical Support gemeldet haben.
Unser Technischer Support  erstellt  ein offizielles Ticket und schickt Ihnen eine erste Rückmeldung in Kürze.
Bitte warten Sie auf die offizielle Ticket Antwort und antworten Sie nicht auf diese E-Mail. Diese Mailbox wird nicht überwacht.

additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0436133 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
DE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
As per the end customer -(E.ON Drive Infrastructure GmbH) request to update the firmware from version 6.0 to 7.0, since the charger is showing offline on SCB and the XF3 router is offline, a remote update is not possible. We need to schedule a site intervention to check the router's functionality by logging into the WebUI. Please bring a spare router, an extra SIM card, and a couple of Ethernet cables. Once the charger is brought online, we can update the firmware to the latest version 7.0 as it has already been rolled out.
Router MLFB : 8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8.
